title: Rotated Array Queries
statement:
Find the minimum element of a cyclic rotation of a strictly increasing array, then use binary search to answer membership queries.

Input
n q, the n rotated values, then q query values.

Output
For each target print its original 1-based position in the given rotation, or 0 if absent.

Constraints
1 ≤ n ≤ 200000. Array values have absolute value at most 10⁹. 1 ≤ q ≤ 200000. Targets have absolute value at most 10⁹.
